units.source_text: 话说那夕颜朝露似的短命而死，源氏公子异常悲恸，左思右想，无法自慰。

en.t: It is said that Yugao died young, as fleeting as morning dew, and Prince Genji was overcome with grief, turning it over and over in his mind, unable to console himself.

units.source_text: 虽然事过半载，始终不能忘怀。

en.t: Although half a year had passed since then, he still could not forget her.

units.source_text: 别的女人，像葵姬或六条妃子，都骄矜成性，城府甚深，丝毫不肯让人。

en.t: Other women, such as Lady Aoi or the Rokujo consort, were all proud by nature, deeply guarded, and unwilling to yield to anyone in the slightest.

units.source_text: 只有这夕颜温良驯善，和蔼可亲，与他人迥不相同，实在很可恋慕。

en.t: Only Yugao was gentle, obedient, warm, and approachable, utterly unlike the others, and truly someone he could long for with affection.

units.source_text: 他虽遭挫折，终不自惩，总想再找一个身份不高而品貌端妍、无须顾忌的人。

en.t: Although he had suffered this setback, he never learned to restrain himself, and always wanted to find another woman of modest rank, graceful in looks and character, with whom he need have no reservations.

units.source_text: 因此凡略有声誉的女子，没有一个不保留在源氏公子的心目中。

en.t: For that reason, every woman with even a slight reputation remained somewhere in Prince Genji's thoughts.

units.source_text: 其中稍具姿色、差强人意的人，他总得送封三言两语的信去暗示情愫；

en.t: Among them, whenever a woman had some beauty and seemed passably pleasing, he would make sure to send a brief letter hinting at his feelings;

units.source_text: 收到了信而置若罔闻或远而避之的人，几乎一个也没有。

en.t: and there was hardly a single woman who, after receiving such a letter, ignored it or kept her distance to avoid him.

units.source_text: 这也未免太平淡无奇了。

en.t: This too was, after all, rather too ordinary and unremarkable.
